{{Quote|There's civil war on Ord Mantell. It's a no-fly zone. Dock at the orbital station there and contact me.|General [[Var Suthra]] sends a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] to the station|<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
The '''Ord Mantell Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Located in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] of the [[Bright Jewel Cluster/Legends|Bright Jewel Cluster]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], the station served as a way-station for passing starships. Travelers who wished to visit the surface of the [[Separatist War|war-torn]] word had to land aboard the station and take a shuttle down to the planet.

==History==
[[File:Ferav_and_Kira.png|thumb|left|250px|Ferav holds Carsen hostage.]]
In [[3643 BBY]], an [[Hero of Tython|unknown]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived on the station and traveled to the planet's surface with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[T7-O1]], leaving the Knight's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] aboard the station to get the lay of the land. However, Sith spies aboard noticed her presence and contacted the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], who arrived with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hacklin]] and [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] [[Ferav]]. Ferav and Angral interrogated Carsen on the Knight's location, but she convinced them that her master was heading to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Angral and Hacklin departed the station, leaving Ferav behind with the Padawan. When the Knight and T7 returned to the station, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the droid were forced to rescue Kira from Ferav, killing the Sith in the progress.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ord Mantell Orbital Station was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the spaceport for the Republic-only planet of Ord Mantell, and can only be accessed by Republic players with their own ship. Players then can take a shuttle down to the planet's surface.<ref name="TOR" /> In the Jedi Knight class storyline, the player is forced to duel Inquisitor Ferav upon returning to the station before they can depart.<ref name="New Intelligence" />
